title: Cursor split panel
description: A full-width paper panel with a hairline and 4px corners: a narrow text column, vertically centred, beside a media frame that takes about two thirds of the width and sits 17px in from the panel's edges. The media can sit on either side; on phones the text comes first and the media below it.
notes: the media frame's height or aspect ratio comes from mediaClassName
name: cursor-split-panel

props.name: media
props.description: the media frame's content (e.g. a CursorMedia placeholder or an image)

props.name: mediaSide
props.description: which side the media sits on from the desktop layout up

props.name: mediaClassName
props.description: size of the media frame (height or aspect ratio, radius)
